concept.title: Topdown performance analysis
concept.shortdesc: Topdown analysis provides a structured way to interpret processor performance data and identify where execution resources may be underutilised.

conbody.p: Processor telemetry can produce many individual measurements. A structured analysis method helps engineers interpret those measurements in a consistent way rather than examining counters independently.

section.title: Using telemetry metrics
section.p: Metrics can be organised into progressively more detailed categories, allowing an investigation to move from a high-level observation toward more specific causes of performance behaviour.

section.title: Analysis workflow
section.p: A Topdown-style workflow begins with broad performance characteristics and uses additional telemetry information to investigate areas that require further analysis.

section.title: Why structured analysis is useful
section.p: Using a defined analysis approach can make performance investigations more repeatable and can help communicate findings consistently across engineering teams.
